subject.title: Split default provider list into agent (tool-capable) and vision models

question: Does current capability-aware provider selection fully satisfy this issue, or should Peekaboo expose separate persisted agent and vision provider defaults?
rationale: Released behavior addresses the observable incompatibility without new configuration, while the issue also proposes a distinct user-facing configuration contract that cannot be inferred from code alone.

options.title: Accept capability filtering
options.body: Treat first-compatible model selection as the intended contract and close this issue after maintainer confirmation.

options.title: Add scoped provider defaults
options.body: Keep this issue open to define separate agent and vision settings with backward-compatible precedence and migration behavior.

recommendation.title: Accept capability filtering
recommendation.body: Treat first-compatible model selection as the intended contract and close this issue after maintainer confirmation.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored both the issue and the relevant released provider-selection behavior, making them the strongest available owner for clarifying the intended remaining scope.
